title: U Mass - Resistin Assay Protocol
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x4kfquw
materials: Allow reagents and assay plate to come to room temperature. Gently remove well contents and wash plate 3x following the instructions listed in the Plate Washing section.
Add 50 µL of Detection Antibodies into each well. Allow the Detection Antibodies to warm to room temperature prior to addition.

steps.title: Prepare Plate with Assay Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Assay Buffer into each well of the plate.

substeps.instruction: Mix on a plate shaker for 10 minutes at room temperature (20-25°C).

steps.title: Remove Assay Buffer
steps.instruction: Decant Assay Buffer and remove residual amounts from all wells.

substeps.instruction: Invert the plate and tap it smartly onto absorbent towels several times.

steps.title: Add Standards, Controls, and Samples
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of each Standard, Control, or sample into the appropriate wells.

substeps.instruction: For serum or plasma samples, use the provided Serum Matrix.
For tissue culture or other supernatants, use proper control culture medium as the matrix solution.

steps.title: Add Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the Mixing Bottle and add 25 μL of mixed or premixed beads to each well.

substeps.instruction: Shake the bead bottle intermittently during addition to avoid settling.

steps.title: Incubate Beads Overnight
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with a plate sealer and wrap with foil.

substeps.instruction: Incubate with agitation on a plate shaker overnight (18~20 hours) at 4°C.

steps.title: Incubate at Room Temperature
steps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 30 minutes at room temperature (20~25°C).

substeps.instruction: Do not aspirate after this incubation.

steps.title: Add Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin to each well containing the 50 µL of Detection Antibodies.

steps.title: Secondary Incubation
steps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 30 minutes at room temperature (20~25°C).

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Gently remove well contents and wash the plate 3x.

substeps.instruction: Let plate soak on magnet for 60 seconds to allow complete settling of magnetic beads.
Wash plate with 200 µL/well of Wash Buffer.
Allow beads to soak for 60 seconds, then remove Wash Buffer by aspiration.
Repeat these wash steps as recommended (or use Bio-Tek ELx405 plate washer with instructed settings).

steps.title: Resuspend Beads
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of Sheath Fluid to all wells.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the beads on a plate shaker for 5 minutes.
Set parameters for 125 µl and 75 beads per bead set.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Save and analyze the Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) data.

substeps.instruction: Use a 5-parameter logistic or spline curve-fitting method to calculate cytokine/chemokine concentrations.
For diluted samples, multiply the calculated concentration by the dilution factor.
